UNIVERSITY INSTITUTE OF ENGINEERING AND TECHNOLOGY (UIET)
PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH – 160014, INDIA
Reference no. 3522/UIET Dated: 23-09-2026
ADVERTISEMENT FOR ONE FULL-TIME PhD FELLOWSHIP
Under Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme for Electronics & IT – Phase II
(Sanctioned by Digital India Corporation, MeitY, Government of India)
Applications are invited for One Full-Time PhD fellowship under the Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme – Phase II, funded by
the Digital India Corporation (DIC), MeitY, Government of India, for Academic Year 2026–27.
Important: This fellowship is strictly limited to candidates making fresh applications for PhD admission in the following
branches of UIET, Panjab University:
● Computer Science and Engineering (CSE)
● Information Technology (IT)
● Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE)
Financial Support for Full-Time PhD Fellow
● Fellowship: ₹46,250/month in 1st & 2nd year; ₹52,500/month in 3rd to 5th year (or until PhD completion,
whichever is earlier)
● Reimbursement of Rent (RoR): @ 16% of the monthly fellowship, i.e., ₹7,400/month in 1st & 2nd year and
₹8,400/month in 3rd to 5th year
● Research Contingency Grant: ₹1.20 lakh/year
● One-time support of ₹1.5 lakh for International Conference
● Visit to Labs Abroad: One-time support for a 6-month visit from the 3rd year, with ₹1.5 lakh/month fellowship
and travel/visa support up to ₹1.5 lakh, as per scheme guidelines
Eligibility Criteria
● Must fulfil Panjab University PhD admission norms available at
https://rdc.puchd.ac.in/show-noticeboard.php?nbid=30
● Must be a fresh applicant for PhD admission in UIET (CSE/IT/ECE) for Academic Year 2026–27
● Must not have availed or be availing any other Central/State fellowship
● Must secure written consent from a UIET faculty supervisor from the eligible branches
● Inter-departmental or institutional transfers are not permitted under this scheme
Application Procedure
1. Contact an eligible supervisor in UIET (CSE/IT/ECE) and obtain consent.
2. Apply online via: https://forms.gle/nfxYpgtzbdKDspBU6
Important Dates
● Application Opens: 23rd-September, 2026 (Wednesday)
● Last Date to Apply: 5th October, 2026 (Monday)
Terms & Conditions:
The detailed Terms & Conditions for the Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme – Phase II are available at:
Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme – Phase II Guidelines
Candidates are advised to carefully read the official guidelines regarding eligibility, fellowship, Research-on-Roll (RoR),
contingency, selection, and other applicable conditions before submitting their applications.
For Further Information: Panjab University – Jobs/Advertisements UIET, Panjab University
For any Queries: Prof. (Dr.) Mamta Juneja (Nodal Officer), 9878677624, visvesvaraya.uiet@gmail.com
